name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 5 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2025-05-23, at wavelengths from 1.19 to 4.91 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
